description: Schema for tool-execution-result entities. Each entity records a single run of a scheduled tool: which tool ran, when it started and finished, its status, and arbitrary result content. A run may have child tool-execution-result entities (linked as related entities) that record sub-tasks and incremental progress.

tool-name.description: The name of the tool that produced this result.

start-time.description: The UTC time at which the tool run started, as an RFC 3339 date-time.

end-time.description: The UTC time at which the tool run finished, as an RFC 3339 date-time. Absent while the run is still in progress.

status.description: The current status of the tool run.
